clauses.reason: Sec. 1-403: 'Executive Order No. 12062 of May 26, 1978, is revoked.' A completed revocation of another order, executed on signing 1978-12-14. The Commission's termination on 1980-03-15 does not undo or end that act, so this clause stays part of the order until the order itself is revoked: first end = EO 12258 sec. 1-103(g), effective 1980-12-31. The revocation of EO 12062 is not undone by the later revocation of EO 12103 (see savings_residuals).

savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_12258 (EO 12258, 46 FR 1251-1252, read once in full): sec. 1-103(g) revokes EO 12103 'as amended' as an order that established a committee that has 'terminated or whose work is completed'; sec. 1-105 makes it effective 1980-12-31; there is no savings, pending-matter, transfer or exception provision, and sec. 1-101 does not continue the Commission. Own-residual check, reading EO 12103 in full (secs. 1-101 to 1-403): sec. 1-403 revoked EO 12062 of May 26, 1978 (the earlier coal commission order) on signing 1978-12-14, a completed act on another order; EO 12258 revokes EO 12103 without any revival wording and does not list EO 12062, and revoking a revoking order does not by itself revive the order it revoked, so EO 12062 stays revoked: an effect of EO 12103 survives it. The rest of the order set up an advisory commission, its staff and expenses, and a final report; no function, fund or property was transferred and no right created. S0 prefill (none_after_bounded_search) OVERRULED to transferred_or_accrued because of the completed revocation of EO 12062. Bounded search: EO 12103, EO 12176 and EO 12258 in full; a by-number scan of all held FR-original texts; OFR catalog edges (EDGES.csv: EO 12103 revoked EO 12062; amended by EO 12176; revoked by EO 12258).

research_rationale: EO 12103 (signed 1978-12-14, 43 FR 58537), read in full from the held FR text, establishes the President's Commission on the Coal Industry 'to modify and continue' the earlier commission (sec. 1-1), sets its functions and administration (secs. 1-2, 1-3), requires the final report 'not later than one year from the date of this Order' and ends the Commission 'one year from the date' of the order (secs. 1-401, 1-402), and revokes EO 12062 (sec. 1-403). The machine own-term kinds are a fixed_term (1-402: 1979-12-14), a report_deadline (1-401) and conditions (staffing and support); reports and conditions are never ends. EO 12176 (44 FR 70705, held FR text, read in full), signed 1979-12-07 with no effective-date wording, revised secs. 1-401 and 1-402 so the report is due 'no later than March 15, 1980' and 'The Commission shall terminate on March 15, 1980'; it came before the original expiry, so the Commission's own term ended 1980-03-15. No order after EO 12176 extended it: a by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR-original texts finds EO 12103 named only in EO 12176 and EO 12258. EO 12258 sec. 1-103(g) (effective 1980-12-31 per sec. 1-105; reading record scale/readings/LSP-EO_12258.json) revokes the order as one for a committee that had terminated, so it is a later event for the Commission clauses and the first end of sec. 1-403, a completed revocation of EO 12062 that the Commission's expiry does not end. The dossier's records ACT:EO:12103>EO:12176 and >EO:12258 quote American Presidency Project or Opus-zip transcriptions, so the extension and the revocation are cited by the ids of the held official FR texts, ACTOR_TEXT:EO:12176 and ACTOR_TEXT:EO:12258; the dossier lists no missing provision. Inventory correction: the dossier's single 'whole' clause is replaced by 16 clauses, one per numbered section from 1-101 to 1-403. Savings: the S0 prefill is overruled, see savings_residuals.
